## ConsumableStats type

Cyberdeck mechanic levels that are gained permanently upon mod charge.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type ConsumableStats = {
  netrunning_lvl: number;
  netrun_cooldown_lvl: number;
  mod_storage: number;
  crafting_lvl: number;
};
```
